host:sessionProjections.register.message: 注册是异步交接；发布消费者前 await register() 得到 handle，dispose() 释放注册；遗留 callable 返回值仅兼容。init/apply/wire.view 必须同步，状态为 JSON，stateVersion 为非负安全整数。未验证调用方 await 顺序、回调纯度或所有权路径，不证明泄漏或失败。

host:sessionProjections.snapshot.message: snapshot(session, keys) 同步返回 {asOfSeq, values}，仅计算选中的客户端 wire 单元；不含 host-only 状态，不执行持久化加载或证明注册已完成。回调和缓存一致性未验证。

host:sessionProjections.cachedSnapshot.message: cachedSnapshot 仍保留但已弃用：只读已物化单元，不折叠新历史，可能返回 undefined 或不完整 baseline；不能据此决定行为。需要完整客户端值时审阅 snapshot(session, keys)，Host 状态使用保留 handle；未验证调用方用途。

host:sessionProjections.onChanged.message: onChanged 仍逐 key 通知；onEventChanged 每个已提交事件聚合 changes[{key,val}] 与 seq。Remote control/observeProjections 的 projection 帧改为 changes 数组，不再是顶层 key/value；baseline 与 projections 读取保持独立。回调帧消费及订阅清理未验证。

host:sessionProjections.onEventChanged.message: onChanged 仍逐 key 通知；onEventChanged 每个已提交事件聚合 changes[{key,val}] 与 seq。Remote control/observeProjections 的 projection 帧改为 changes 数组，不再是顶层 key/value；baseline 与 projections 读取保持独立。回调帧消费及订阅清理未验证。

host:sessionController.events.message: Session events 是按 seq 分页的持久事件，observeEvent 不附快照；state/observeState 是被动运行状态读取/完整替换，wait 是有界等待而非执行成功证明。control 的 baseline 后跟替换帧；projection 帧使用 changes[{key,val}] 和 seq，未出现 key 表示未变化，observeProjections 同样聚合，follow 从 opening 快照开始跟随持久事件；projections 是独立快照读取，需迁移时可能只给缓存提示或缺失。回调协议、AbortSignal、运行状态转换及远端动态调用未验证。

limits: Only proven Context service calls and fixed host ctx.on agent/request registrations; no returned Agent/Session object flow. Listener callbacks and dynamic event names are not certified.
No callback mutation, purity, await ordering, subscription cleanup or runtime success analysis.
Only startSession known option types/enums and proven registration stateVersion yield nonfatal findings; migration notices do not alter severity.
Exact version only. Old baselines unchanged.

analysisDecisions.agentRequest: Only fixed proven Context.on event identity is recorded; callback proposal mutations and returned Agent.model flow are not analyzed. No route violation finding.
analysisDecisions.draft: Only known scalar types/policy enum; prompt/agentPreset contents are discarded. Async draft application is not proven.
analysisDecisions.projection: Only known stateVersion scalar invalidity is a nonfatal finding; definition keys/callbacks are discarded. Registration await, pure fold and disposal remain notices.
analysisDecisions.session: Client ownership, snapshot APIs and host event/state/control protocols are source-reviewed notices at proven entry calls. Dynamic Remote streams remain unverified.
analysisDecisions.timer: vendor/timer owns the current implementation; legacy setTimeout/setInterval forward to callback helpers and return effect-owned callable disposers.
analysisDecisions.reasoning: rawText versus prepared text and Content Factory input reconfirmed from exact rc1 sources; no callback props-use errors.
